usages.explain: 「がてら」is used to describe the idea of simultaneously doing another action while in the process of doing one action. The action in the latter clause, typically a verb related to movement such as 散歩する (take a walk), 行く (go)... is done as an additional benefit or purpose while doing the main action.

examples.content: 散歩がてら、本屋に行ってくるよ。
examples.transcription: さんぽがてら、ほんやにいってくるよ。
examples.mean: After my walk, I'm going to the bookstore.

examples.content: 桜を見がてら隣の駅まで歩いた。
examples.transcription: さくらをみがてらとなりのえきまであるいた。
examples.mean: I walked to the next station while looking at the cherry blossoms.

examples.content: 遊びがてらお立ち寄りください。
examples.transcription: あそびがてらおたちよりください。
examples.mean: Please stop by and have some fun.

examples.content: ドライブがてら駅に私を迎えに来てください。
examples.transcription: ドライブがてらえきにわたしをむかえにきてください。
examples.mean: Please come and pick me up at the station.

examples.content: 出かけがてらたばこを買って来てね。
examples.transcription: でかけがてらたばこをかってきてね。
examples.mean: Please buy some cigarettes before you go out.

usages.synopsis:
Vます+がてら
N+がてら

title: がてら => while; on the same occasion; at the same time; coincidentally ~
